headline: Scoring Piore & Sabel's Exit 1 on 1984-2026 data across 7 pre-declared signatures: the evidence points to neither exit - the second-unbundling reading (threshold-sensitive); no hypothesis reaches the >=4-signature bar (full favors on live cells H-A 0, H-B 0, H-C 2).
replication_score_note: not applicable (book; GO-WITH-SCOPE) - no replication score exists or is computed (R5); verdict-count tallies below are structured, not a pooled score.

metrics.label: China share of world manufacturing VA (2004->2023)
metrics.note: M1: hub concentration. Schwartz 2024 output/VA inversion (China 35% output vs 29% VA; US 12%/16%, 2023) = a MODERNIZED OPERATIONALIZATION (Kaplinsky/Schwartz), NOT a book prediction.

metrics.label: US mfg small-establishment (<100) emp share (1978->2011->2023)
metrics.note: M2: long-run smallization then E3 re-concentration; EU concordant. mean estab size 58.7->39.2->45.8. PS-PROV-2 correction: EU share relabeled 2005->2011 (EU27_2020 SBS absent pre-2011 in staged file; '2005-2020' is the dataset's nominal span). CSV already honest (year=2011); E3 window (2011-2026) unaffected.

metrics.label: GVC/task-trade participation (S3, TiVA-degraded fallback)
metrics.note: M3: source = fallback (TiVA endpoint degraded, verified 2026-10-27 and at run time). SoP label [PREVIEW-KNOWN]; 2011 boundary [SOURCE-DERIVED: WTO GVC Report 2025 plateau finding].

metrics.label: Evidence-grid column tallies (favors / weakly favors / against) + full favors on live cells
metrics.baseline: >=4 full favors on live cells needed; none reached
metrics.note: M4: S4 capped weak, so k=4 max full favors per hypothesis. Verdict routed via split+S3.

metrics.label: Demand-management institutions required vs existing (S6, ex-ante doc.)
metrics.baseline: developing-world mobile subs/100 ~0 (1995) -> China 128, Viet Nam 131 (2023)
metrics.note: M5: institutional half of Exit 1 absent; mass consumption arrived on market terms (WTO-era integration), not via 'multinational Keynesianism'.

figures.caption: Evidence grid: 7 signatures x 3 hypotheses. Verdict: neither - the unbundling reading (threshold-sensitive); no hypothesis reaches >=4 full favors on live cells.
figures.alt: 7x3 color-coded grid; H-C column shows favors for S1, S3, S6 and weakly-favors elsewhere; H-A and H-B have no full favors.

figures.caption: S1: China hub concentration of manufacturing VA (left) and US plant-size smallization-then-E3-re-concentration (right), era-shaded. The production unit splits by geography and era.
figures.alt: Left: China share of world manufacturing VA rising to ~28% while US falls; right: US small-establishment share rising to 2011 then falling, mean size mirror-imaged.

figures.caption: S3: WITS UNCTAD-SoP export mix (intermediate share flat in [PREVIEW-KNOWN] band) and the WTO rise-then-plateau GVC-participation summary (TiVA endpoint degraded -> fallback).
figures.alt: Left: four SoP export-share lines, intermediate flat ~20-25%; right: text panel summarizing GVC participation rising 1995-2011 then plateauing, 48%->46.3% share, ~30% US-China decoupling.

notes: BOOK under GO-WITH-SCOPE: no Phase-1 replication and no replication score, by design (R5). Verdict tallies are structured, not a pooled score.

P2 provisional anchor is graded as worded (PROVISIONAL-PENDING-H1); gate A1b re-run at run start, 6/6 inherited P2 locators hit -> anchor live (Schwartz, Berger, Bhengu). No output asserts 'the book says X at p.Y' or 'the book predicted China'.
H-A hub-concentration and profit-structure (output/VA inversion) components are MODERNIZED OPERATIONALIZATIONS by Kaplinsky 2023 / Schwartz 2024, not book components.
Fork-not-forecast: 'The book posed Exit 1 and Exit 2 as politically contingent possibilities, not forecasts; neither exit's non-realization is, by itself, a failed prediction.'

TiVA endpoint degraded (HTTP 500) at run time -> binding WTO+WITS fallback for S3 (logged in fetch_log.json). INDSTAT excluded (H3). Pre-2004 China VA share not substituted (specced source not staged).
Steel PREVIEW label stated China ~91.6% BOF (the 91.6 is the Austria row in the staged worldsteel table); computed China BOF = 89.8%, US majority-EAF (71.8%) confirmed.
Labels [PREVIEW-KNOWN] (flat SoP; steel split) and [SOURCE-DERIVED] (2011 boundary) are carried, not 'pre-registered'/'validated' (PS-C1). Threshold-sensitive: H-C clears only via the split+S3 route.
